label: 1. Are you the Commander everyone's talking about?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Are you the Commander everyone's talking about?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: The one who's willing to accept nearly any request?
That's me.
That's not entirely correct.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: You don't say...

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Well, I don't care.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: whether you do or don't.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Right now,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: my heart is telling me that you're the one who can make my dreams come true.
You better start making sense, real quick.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I... want to go fishing!

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: My soul cries out for it.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I must experience this in my lifetime.
Excuse me?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Ah, perhaps

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: you don't know what fishing is?
What is it?
I've heard of it.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: As I expected.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Understandable, really.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: The act of fishing has slowly been lost to history.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Impressive! But nevertheless, let me help you fill in the blanks.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Fishing is

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: using the fishing rod as a means

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: to realize your dreams!!

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: You must help me find a fishing rod!

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: An expensive one.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Using a homemade rod in the bathtub

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: is not enough to satisfy me.
Are there no fishing rods in the Ark?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: There are, but

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: the genuine articles are all in museums.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I tried to "borrow" one, but got caught

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: and ended up doing some jail time.
I see.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: So, I'm begging you.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Let these hands of mine

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: realize their dream of holding a true, genuine fishing rod.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I will make it worth your while.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Do you need anything? Name it.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I will do everything in my power to help you.
Just tell me where you need me to go.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Certainly!
